'''Advozsec''' (singular: '''Advozse''') were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], easily distinguished by the single horn on top of their [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] heads. Their home planet of [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]] was geologically unstable, with frequent volcanic eruptions: a condition which shaped their culture and their place in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Advozsec were evolved from herbivorous [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]]-analogs which fed on the vegetation known to form around the planet [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor's]] hot springs. Evolving into a class of [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammal]], the Advozsec had a single black horn at the crown of their heads, four digits on each hand and foot, pointed ears, and large black eyes. Their skin varied from yellow to dark brown. Advozsec were strictly [[Vegetarian/Legends|vegetarian]], being unable to properly digest meat.<ref name="GG12" /> At least some members of the species had sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="DTH">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Down the Hole|Tatooine}}</ref>

The Advozsec home planet of [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]] was geologically unstable, with frequent volcanic eruptions. The geothermal hot springs that appear on their homeworld forced the species to evolve thick skin in order to survive. The large, black eyes of the Advozsec were adaptations to the clouds of volcanic ash which darkened Riflor's skies. Though they were most comfortable in the naturally dim light of their homeworld, Advozsec could adjust to levels of light found on other worlds with minimal discomfort.<ref name="GG12" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Advozse_GG12.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An Advozse]]
Since so much of the sunlight on Riflor was blocked by volcanic eruptions, Advozsec tended to settle near geothermal springs for heat. Unfortunately, these springs also tended to be in geologically unstable regions, and anything built near them was often destroyed or abandoned due to eruptions or [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. As a result, the Advozse people ended up having little attachment to material goods or long-term plans, and developed a pessimistic, selfish, and even paranoid outlook on life. This facet of their culture remained long after contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] gave them access to modern construction techniques allowing for more permanent buildings.<ref name="GG12" /> Seeing financial stability as the only truly achievable stability one could find in life, the Advozsec constantly strove to accumulate as much monetary wealth as they could in a lifetime in order to have the ability to rebuild when the worst happened.<ref name="UAA" />

Reading and writing the language [[Advb]], Advozsec generally used a first name and a second name. Typical names included Kol Nurn, Roda Lem, and Vel Ramdro.<ref name="UAA" /> Other Advozsec, such as the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Tulak]] and his son [[Kalut]], were only known by a single name.<ref name="YT">{{Tales|5|Yaddle's Tale: The One Below}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Great Galactic War|Great War]], the Advozse participated actively in the conflict against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but the postwar period left their homeworld and society in a marginalized state. The Empire regarded them primarily as a pool of slaves and mercenaries, whereas the Republic, preoccupied with postwar reconstruction, was unable to defend them. As dissatisfaction mounted over this lack of support, a radical faction of separatists emerged, eventually seceding to form an independent splinter government known as the [[Advozse Hegemony]], led by Battlelord [[Kreshan]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia|''Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia'']]</ref>

Gaining representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the species was often perceived as being decent bureaucrats. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Riflor's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Silvu Donte]] attempted to secede from the Republic<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref> but the planet was quickly placed under the guardianship of the [[Nineteenth Army|19th Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was unable to support the Separatist cause in any substantial way. Despite this, a strong Separatist leaning permeated the society and representatives of the Republic were not welcome.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, Advozsec involved in Riflor's rich mining operations were cut off from planetary decision making by their Imperial overseers. While most Advozsec supported the Empire, with many serving in its bureaucracy, the Imperial forces on Riflor had to put down several protests demanding a greater Advozse voice. In the decades following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the world was attacked by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] as they waged their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|campaign of conquest and terror]] across the galaxy. In lieu of an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] the Yuuzhan Vong [[Biological attack on Riflor|unleashed]] a biological weapon on Riflor, resulting in the destruction of ninety-seven percent of the planet's flora and the starvation of millions; more Advoszec died when the agent targeted their immune systems. Those Advoszec who survived traded information to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in return for food and supplies, while members of the species who were offworld at the time of Riflor's devastation pessimistically awaited the Yuuzhan Vong's total victory over the galaxy.<ref name="GamerAdv">{{GamerCite|4|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Advozsec}}</ref> However, such an outcome never came to pass, as the invaders' crusade was ultimately derailed in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="NewChron">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Advozsec in the galaxy==
[[File:Advozse_Mercenary_EM.png|thumb|right|200px|An Advozse mercenary]]
As part of galactic society, the skeptical and control-oriented Advozse temperament led many of them into bureaucratic careers with large corporations or the Republic.<ref name="GG12" /> Other Advozsec were enemies of the Republic, however. These included the warlord [[Tulak]] who ravaged the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koba]] in circa [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], and Tulak's son [[Kalut]], who attacked Koba a century later.<ref name="YT" />

Some Advozsec turned to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] or became smugglers themselves to get around high Imperial tariffs during the Galactic Civil War. [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]], a smuggler who was often seen at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]], was one of the most prominent Advozsec during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG12" /> Another Advozse involved with illicit trade, [[Gjeel Dhantra]], served as [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] for [[Pok Nar-Ten]], the [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]] representative on [[Boztrok]].<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref> One famous Advozse was [[Grelk Micabra]], who was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racing champion of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="SWTS">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Advozsec existed, as evidenced by a Advozse [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who joined the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]<ref name="JvS3" /> One Advosec known to have joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was [[Goril Sevintran]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Advosze makeup was created by [[Rick Baker]] for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The character that appeared in the cantina scene was nicknamed "[[Wikipedia:Don Rickles|Don Rickles]]" by the production crew due to its resemblance to the insult comic. He would not receive a proper name until 1993, when [[West End Games]] identified him<ref name="rollcall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> in the book [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']].<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
